rule.rule: After 30 paired TL280 runs, consider v6 singleton acceleration and v8 geometric mass balancing against the same paired v5 architecture. A new method is eligible only if every result is valid/rc0/no emergency timeout/below300, equal-input mean against v5 >0 and worst pair against v5 >=-1%. Select highest mean among eligible new methods, otherwise retain v5. Preserve all outcomes; no tuning after fresh generation.
rule.timing: Written before acceleration280 starts; this is development selection, not the independent promotion gate.
